sanitizedEvidence.summary: The complete shared USB root contained cooling-pad traffic but no 90-byte laptop feature-report transaction during the marker-aligned HyperBoost apply or Balanced restore.

The product-736 middleware log recorded paired thermal-mode calls during the apply and restore windows. This confirms Synapse attempted semantic mode changes, but it does not establish the transport or independent readback.

Synapse opened the laptop MI_02 HID interface and submitted feature reports through node-rz-hid. That exact devnode has RzDev_02e0 as an upper filter and a same-PID RZCONTROL child serviced by RzCommon. Marker-aligned Procmon events did not reveal an attributable HyperBoost DeviceIoControl path or IOCTL buffer.

The same full-root capture proves the cooling pad uses a directly accessible 90-byte Razer body and returns status-02 ACK responses for observed fan, mode, brightness, and effect setters. Lighting frame 0F/03 remains host-streamed without a response.

limitations: The observed path is a filter-mediated Windows HID submission. The capture does not prove whether the upper filter completes locally, translates the request, or forwards through another path.
The absence of laptop USB traffic disproves a physical-USB capture claim for this session; physical firmware transport remains unresolved.
Procmon records operation metadata but not DeviceIoControl input and output buffers, and no action-aligned attributable HyperBoost IOCTL was observed.
Installed middleware statically defines thermal mode 7 and a thermal getter, but the trace contains no independent mode-7 getter result.
The capture does not prove HyperBoost power-limit changes, firmware enforcement of cooling-pad presence, safe pad-less activation, or support on another model or firmware.
No OpenBlade write, candidate replay, pad-presence spoof, or pad-less activation was attempted.

productionAdmission.reason: The laptop transport and independent HyperBoost readback remain unresolved; cooling-pad fan state lacks an observed getter; lighting physical order, display-off behavior, persistence, and rate tolerance remain incomplete.

notes: USBPcap stopped by targeted graceful Ctrl+Break; Procmon finalized; no capture process remained running.
The raw PCAP, PML rollovers, decoded transactions, capture state, and operator markers remain local and uncommitted.
OpenBlade was restarted after capture cleanup.
